# azureadb2c_trust_framework_key_set (Resource)

Manages one Azure AD B2C policy key container (key set) and its key. The key is either generated by B2C or uploaded from a secret. Any change replaces the key set. The secret is never read back.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# B2C generates an RSA signing key.
resource "azureadb2c_trust_framework_key_set" "token_signing" {
  id       = "B2C_1A_TokenSigningKeyContainer"
  use      = "sig"
  key_type = "RSA"
}

# B2C generates an RSA encryption key.
resource "azureadb2c_trust_framework_key_set" "token_encryption" {
  id       = "B2C_1A_TokenEncryptionKeyContainer"
  use      = "enc"
  key_type = "RSA"
}

# Upload a secret without storing it in state (Terraform 1.11+).
# Bump secret_wo_version to upload a new value; that replaces the key set.
variable "facebook_app_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "azureadb2c_trust_framework_key_set" "facebook" {
  id                = "B2C_1A_FacebookSecret"
  use               = "sig"
  key_type          = "oct"
  secret_wo         = var.facebook_app_secret
  secret_wo_version = 1
}

# Upload a secret that is kept in state (any Terraform version).
variable "api_connector_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "azureadb2c_trust_framework_key_set" "api_connector" {
  id       = "B2C_1A_RestApiKey"
  use      = "enc"
  key_type = "oct"
  secret   = var.api_connector_secret
  expires  = 1893456000 # 2030-01-01T00:00:00Z
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Container name including the B2C_1A_ prefix, e.g. B2C_1A_TokenSigningKeyContainer. Only letters and digits are allowed after the prefix.
- `key_type` (String) Key type: RSA or oct. An uploaded secret must be oct.
- `use` (String) Key usage: sig (signature) or enc (encryption).

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `expires` (Number) Time the key expires, in Unix seconds (Graph exp).
- `not_before` (Number) Time the key becomes valid, in Unix seconds (Graph nbf).
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret to upload (key_type oct only). Stored in state; prefer secret_wo. When neither is set, B2C generates the key.
- `secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only secret to upload (key_type oct only); never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later. Change secret_wo_version to upload a new value.
- `secret_wo_version` (Number) Version of secret_wo. Changing it replaces the key set with the current secret_wo. Only valid with secret_wo.

### Read-Only

- `key_id` (String) Key id (kid) of the active key.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a key set by its container id. The secret is never read back, so
# secret / secret_wo stay unset after the import.
terraform import azureadb2c_trust_framework_key_set.token_signing B2C_1A_TokenSigningKeyContainer
```
